steps.together: Last step: the {cScale} with both hands, an octave apart. The thumbs pass under at different moments in each hand, so go slowly and watch your fingers.
steps.inTime: Up and down in time, slowly.
steps.minuet: A real dance to end the unit: the “Minuet in {g}”, from the music book of Anna Magdalena Bach. Each {f} is {fSharp}, as the key signature says, and the thumbs pass under in both hands.
steps.minuetInTime: And in time: a minuet is a dance in 3/4, one step per beat.
